_readme: Films shown in the Screening Room on the home page (src/components/VideoShowcase.astro). Add entries to "videos", newest first: the first YouTube entry becomes the featured film, the rest form the programme list. Entry shape: { "platform": "youtube" | "instagram" | "tiktok", "id": "the YouTube video id, e.g. the part after watch?v= (YouTube only)", "url": "the full link to the post (Instagram and TikTok only)", "title": "the title as shown on the site", "published": "optional date, YYYY-MM-DD", "poster": "optional still image, a path inside public/ such as photos/florian/bus.jpg" }. YouTube films play on the page, but only after the visitor presses play (nothing is requested from YouTube before that). Instagram and TikTok entries are shown as links that open the platform. Without a poster a designed title plate is shown; thumbnails are never fetched from YouTube. While the list is empty the section shows the three channels instead. Only add real, published videos.
